reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing pre-link guard pattern (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked) with a sibling ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking, though it does not fold the two into one shared pre-link check.

duplication.why: The closed rule is defined once; only the two-line guard call is repeated in each of the six provider handlers, mirroring the existing guard.

placement.why: Sits next to the existing link guard in accounts/app.ts, run before any write in each link handler.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six calls and a test.

maintainability.why: Clear and small; a seventh provider must remember two guard calls instead of one shared pre-link step.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking, called by all six provider link handlers
